title: Coal Forge
pages: Craft the controller from a coal block, a Cured Dry-Lube Bearing (top right), a solar tempered plate from the Solar Smelter, two magma blocks, an anvil, two sealed steel plates and a nickel ingot. It is a six-course, north-facing smithy: the 3x3 hearth has a 3-wide work apron extending two blocks south. Build it from the bottom up. Course 1 is a magma block under the controller, ringed by eight stone bricks as the hearth plinth. Course 2 holds the controller, with a coal block directly east and west of it and bricks in the four corners; leave the blocks directly north and south of the controller open for item ports. Course 3 has only the four corner brick pillars, leaving open working gaps above the coal. Course 4 is a full ring of eight bricks forming the hood, open above the controller. Courses 5 and 6 are the chimney: four bricks each, on the sides of the open flue. At the bottom course, extend the stone-brick plinth with three more stone bricks two blocks south of the controller; place an undamaged anvil on the center apron brick at controller height, flanked by a coal block (the coal bins) on each side apron brick. Face the apron south (the front of the fixed north-facing blueprint). The forge has 41 required blocks. A Structure Projector bound to the controller shows each course in turn. It is a tier-5 device: its Cupel Tongs replace the lead ingot in the Assay Cupel Hearth recipe, whose Assay Bead leads on to the Wire Drawing Bench, the Enamel Kiln and the Heliostat Etcher.

The hearth blower turns right beside the fire, where ordinary grease would bake out, so its shaft runs on a dry-film bearing. Make two Dry Lubricant Compound from two Molybdenum Grit (crushed molybdenite, a molybdenum disulfide stand-in), any coal or charcoal as the graphite and a honeycomb as the binder. Combine one compound with a Deep Groove Ball Bearing into a Filled Dry-Lube Bearing, then cure it in the Clinker Oven (200 ticks, 12 FE/t) into a Cured Dry-Lube Bearing. The uncured bearing, a plain ball bearing, Bearing Grease or a coal block cannot fill that slot. Automate the cure with hoppers like any clinkering job. Real filled bearings of this kind (graphite, MoS2 and a resin binder injected into the bearing and cured) are rated to roughly 250 C open or 350 C shielded; the game does not simulate bearing temperature or wear.

Hold the metal stock in your main hand and the fuel in your off hand, then right-click the formed controller. Each click loads one heat: the listed ingot count and the listed number of coal or charcoal (tag minecraft:coals, 1 to 8) move into the forge's buffers. The piece is forged after 40 ticks; right-click with an empty hand to collect it. While a heat is loaded the forge refuses different stock and keeps what you hold. Without enough fuel the forge refuses, tells you how much it needs and uses nothing. Stock is matched by forge:ingots/<metal> tags, so any mod's matching ingot works. Removing any plinth, wall, pillar, hood, chimney, apron, coal bin or anvil block stops the forge. A stone brick in place of a brick also stops it. Reach the controller through the open gaps of course 3 or its open north and south faces.

It runs 21 datapack forging recipes, each on a different stock, turning metals you smelt in bulk into iron-grade goods without spending iron. Four iron and 3 fuel give the Cupel Tongs. Tools: vanadium pickaxe (4), molybdenum axe (4), tantalum shovel (2), niobium hoe (3), cobalt sword (3), manganese shears (2). Armour: titanium helmet (6), osmium chestplate (9), hafnium leggings (8), zirconium boots (5). Fittings: chromium gives 2 buckets, nickel a cauldron, tungsten (24) an anvil, aluminum 2 iron doors, tin an iron trapdoor, lead a minecart, gold a bell, zinc a hopper and one rhenium a flint and steel. One Steel Billet and one fuel are hot-headed into four Hex Bolt Sets (bolt plus nut): the bar end is upset into a hex head, the way the first bolts were forged; modern factories cold-head and roll threads instead, which the game abstracts. The Noctilucent Condenser needs two to bolt down its base flange.

Automation: insert metal stock into slot 0 and coal or charcoal into slot 1 from the north face; a hopper fills whichever slot accepts the item. Sneak-click with an empty hand to cycle the south face to output, then extract the forged pieces there. A formed forge runs a heat every 40 ticks; missing fuel, too little stock or a broken smithy pauses it without consuming stored items. Stock, fuel and the face setting survive save/load. Charcoal from a tree farm is a renewable fuel. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. Creative players forge without spending stock or fuel. JEI's Forging category lists the stock tag and count, the fuel count and the result, with the Coal Forge as catalyst.
